Scenario fixture: form-control-programmatic-label-quality

This is a MANUAL rule: automatic outcomes are restricted to cantTell (at least one applicable control's primary label method is title or placeholder) and notApplicable (no applicable controls) — this rule must NEVER produce pass/fail per this repo's manual-rule contract. This fixture is deliberately built so the whole-file aggregate is always cantTell (it includes flagged controls), and every case is checked only for occurrence presence/absence, never for a whole-rule pass/fail outcome. Each target has a stable id fcq_case_NN.

A. Flagged: primary label method is title or placeholder

01 — FLAGGED: placeholder-only (primary method = placeholder)
02 — FLAGGED: title-only (primary method = title)
03 — FLAGGED: both title and placeholder present (title wins priority, still flagged either way)
04 — FLAGGED: textarea with placeholder only

B. Not flagged: primary label method is a strong/medium mechanism

05 — NOT FLAGGED: <label for> association (strong)
06 — NOT FLAGGED: wrapping <label> association (strong)
07 — NOT FLAGGED: aria-labelledby (strong)
Username
08 — FLAGGED: aria-label only, never shown on screen

B2. aria-labelledby: flagged only when every target is unrendered

15 — FLAGGED: aria-labelledby to hidden text
Search
16 — NOT FLAGGED: aria-labelledby to visually hidden (clipped) text
Search
17 — NOT FLAGGED: aria-labelledby to hidden and visible text
SearchSite
18 — NOT FLAGGED: visually hidden (clipped) <label>

C. Applicability / eligibility (role=presentation exception, acc-ineligible exclusions)

09 — FLAGGED: role=presentation but focusable (tabindex=0), placeholder primary
10 — NEUTRAL/EXCLUDED: role=presentation, not focusable (tabindex=-1), excluded from applicability
11 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE (acc): hidden attribute
12 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE (acc): display:none
13 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE (acc): inert subtree

D. Untargeted by selector

14 — NOT TARGETED: input type=submit (excluded by selector)

End of fixture.
